item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `litellm.completion`, constructs `dspy.LM(..., model_type=\"chat\", reasoning_effort=\"low\")`, and calls a non-OpenAI Anthropic chat model."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"`FakeResp` exposes `choices`, `usage`, and `model`, matching the response fields DSPy reads for chat completion processing/history."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"The fake chat function captures outbound kwargs, and the program asserts `captured[0][\"reasoning_effort\"] == \"low\"`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"The fake choice message includes both `content` and non-empty `reasoning_content`, and the asserted result preserves them as `text` and `reasoning_content`."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"It asserts the parsed result is a one-element list containing a dict with both `text` and `reasoning_content`, which is why DSPy does not collapse it to plain strings."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
